Backlink exchange explained
How do credits work?

1. Initial 100 credits
Each website starts with 100 credits which allows them to start receiving backlinks immediately.
2. Earn credits
When you give a backlink, you earn credits equal to your domain rating, up to 25 credits per backlink.
3. Spend credits
When you receive backlinks, credits are spent based on the domain rating of the giving website. Your balance can dip below zero for a while, and it rebalances automatically as you give links.

Where are backlink placed?

Backlinks are embedded naturally within daily articles published by other websites in our network — always within your niche.Each link is placed contextually, meaning it fits naturally into the surrounding content and adds genuine value for the reader. For readers, the link feels relevant and helpful, not forced or out of place. For search engines, contextual dofollow links are recognized as high-quality signals, giving your site a stronger authority boost.
